Visitor replaces button with bracketed text

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_button(self, ctx, text):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return {"type": "custom", "output": f'[BTN:{text}]'}
    html = '<p>Confirm action: <button type="submit">Click me</button> or <button type="reset">Cancel</button></p>'
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
